root.description: Path to folder within the bucket, that should act as root. Defaults to the bucket's top-level directory.
root.title: Custom root path

workerUrl.description: Base URL of the jupyter-drive Cloudflare Worker that fronts the R2 bucket.
workerUrl.title: Worker URL

writeSecret.description: Shared write secret for the Worker (sent as the x-write-secret header on save/upload/delete). Leave empty for read-only access. Anyone who knows this secret can write to the bucket.
writeSecret.title: Write secret
